Job title: Testing- AI engineer

Location: Pune, HYD

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Hybrid




Job Description:

JD for AI Engineers:

Total Work experience ~5-10 years
Frontier agentic models: Knowledge of Frontier agentic models (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini AI, Anthropic Claude etc.,) and building Agentic AI agents.
MCP with Testing agents Selenium, Appium, Playwright, JMeter, Roboframework, commercial tools like TOSCA, TDM, DevTest
Prompt Engineering & Evaluation: Prompting to solve a QA problem, Testing how agents respond to various instructions, chain-of-thought prompts, and few-shot techniques.
Programming: Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript is required for scripting, analyzing agent traces, and customizing test environments. Rapid prototyping
System Architecture & Tooling: Ability to test AI interactions with external tools, APIs, databases, and web services (e.g., verifying tool selection and API payload accuracy).
DevOps expertise (SCM, Jenkins, Ansible)
Testing Expertise (Good to have):
Proficiency in testing tools, Agentic Testing Playwright, Performance Testing- Apache JMeter, API Testing tools Insomnia, Karate, REST Assured.
Writing scripts to automate test cases, debug, and monitor agent actions.
Validating agents functional and technical features, integration with external tools, APIs, and databases (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI).
